space.$description: 4 pt base grid. Between components: 8 · 16 · 24 · 32 · 40 (the 8 pt rhythm). Within a component: the 4 pt grid, with 2 and 12 allowed there as fine breaks. Anything handed over snaps to the nearest 8.

2.$description: Fine break: hairline gaps, glyph nudges.

4.$description: Fine break: icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

12.$description: Within a component only (padding, an invisible hit halo, the watch safe margin) — never between components.

radius.$description: Tight radii: 4 controls and chips · 8 cards · 12 floating panels and sheets. Concentric (inner = outer − padding); a radius never clips content.

full.$description: Capsule: the system switch only. Never chips, pills or buttons.

hairline.$description: 1 px in CSS; 1 / displayScale pt in SwiftUI.

device.$description: Screen widths in points that specimens are shown at. Design in points: every Apple Watch is @2x, every current iPhone @3x.

watch-40mm.$description: Apple Watch 40 mm (162 × 197 pt) — the tightest screen; if it fits here it fits everywhere.

physical.$description: Physical (3D-printed and printed) sizes in millimetres: starting points for FDM with a 0.4 mm nozzle, to be confirmed with a test print. Never emitted to Swift.

stroke-min.$description: Narrowest raised or recessed stroke in text and marks: two nozzle widths.

text-cap-min.$description: Smallest cap height for moulded-in text read at arm’s length. Values and scales: JetBrains Mono (dotted zero).

text-cap-label.$description: Cap height for a label that must be read without picking the part up (warnings, the speed scale).

emboss-depth.$description: Raised text and marks: at least three 0.2 mm layers.

deboss-depth.$description: Recessed text: deep enough to hold an inlay or paint fill.

inlay-depth.$description: A contrasting-filament inlay (two layers at 0.2 mm), flush with the face.

edge-band.$description: The dark band that separates orange from light gray on a part, so the two never meet by hue alone.

label-margin.$description: Clear margin around printed labels and moulded text: the physical safe margin (nothing clipped by a chamfer or fillet).
